CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2528 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312. Bus nonce: 97f2e58ff8bdd429fb144e624ed7b08f. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312` or `Fix review: blocked 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 97f2e58ff8bdd429fb144e624ed7b08f`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2528 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2528-97f2e58f`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA RE-REVIEW of PR #2528 (R10-PREPR-CAP, branch fix/r10-prepr-closures) at head 2af78ed5959f39dbe1e2bdee2efa0298ee198312. Last verdict BLOCKED at 1723d8743619f397bcf9e04a219e1a581f4a736c (`git fetch origin review/2528 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`): ci-red, pr-contract refused the body three times because R10-FLOW-JIDOKA was not on main's roster (BAD-DEST). JIDOKA is on main's roster now; the fixer merged main and rewrote `## Red checks` (fixer tip 20d129b11). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Spare the GitHub API.
Check: 1. The block is cleared: `carry_audit.py check --body` at origin/main reads 0 unrouted and 0 bad, and pr-contract on this head is green (or, if still running, the same check passes locally). 2. `## Red checks` names every red in the branch history (one check-runs read) including the three pr-contract refusals. 3. The PR's own diff against its merge base equals the fix the earlier rounds reviewed apart from the merge of main; every conflict resolution keeps both sides; re-apply the body's mutation-proof mutant(s) and confirm the tests fail. 4. Body figures re-derive at this head; merge-tree with origin/main clean.
Return merge unless an item fails. Time box 30 min.
